verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform like Secureframe, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents letting customers choose where their Secureframe data is stored. The GDPR checks and Azure Government resource monitoring concern customers' own environments, not Secureframe's storage location, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
